name: test-bell
description: Plays a sound when a test run fails (and optionally when it passes).

testBell.enabled.description: Enable or disable the test bell sound.

testBell.playOnSuccess.description: Play a sound when all tests pass.

testBell.volume.description: Volume level (supported on macOS via afplay -v).

testBell.failSound.description: Path to a custom audio file (.wav or .mp3) for test failures. Accepts absolute paths or paths relative to the workspace root.

testBell.passSound.description: Path to a custom audio file (.wav or .mp3) for test passes. Accepts absolute paths or paths relative to the workspace root.
